names.coleman_ames_house_1811_prairie_coach_ho: 1811 S. Prairie Avenue — the alley building of the house at 1811

source.citation: 'To Rent—1811 Prairie-av., 16 room house; light on all sides; beautifully finished; 3 bathrooms, billiard and ball rooms; will decorate to suit tenant; 2 story stable. Holton, Seelye & Co., 204 Dearborn-st.' Classified advertisement, 'To Rent—Houses', Chicago Daily Tribune, 16 April 1904.
what_it_does_not_supply: the stable's plan, roof or material
what_it_supplies: that 1811's alley building was a stable of two storeys in April 1904
that the house was detached, with light on all sides, and empty in spring 1904
